subsystems.name: transport-midi
subsystems.invariants: Beats are primary; use Beats, Seconds, and Bpm, and keep sync_clips_to_time() as playback-state authority. Preserve MIDI phantom ordering and channel guards.

subsystems.name: parameter-ui
subsystems.invariants: UI receives snapshots and sends ContentCommand; project edits go through EditingService and undoable commands. Reuse the existing parameter surface and dirty-check updates.

subsystems.name: metal
subsystems.invariants: GPU access goes through manifold-gpu and native Metal. Avoid per-frame allocations; run GPU proofs through cargo test, never nextest.

subsystems.name: freeze
subsystems.invariants: Preserve freeze compiler contracts and required fusion proofs; resolve current implementation from the compiler map.

subsystems.name: generators-primitives
subsystems.invariants: Read DECOMPOSING_GENERATORS in full, then ADDING_PRIMITIVES. Audit existing primitives before adding one; preserve composability and required fusion proofs.
